I need to consider the 1944 "Bomb Plot," which refers to the July 20, 1944 assassination attempt.

The July 20 Plot (also known as Operation Valkyrie) was indeed an attempt by German military officers to assassinate Adolf Hitler. Colonel Claus von Stauffenberg placed a briefcase bomb in Hitler's Wolf's Lair headquarters in East Prussia. The bomb exploded, but Hitler survived with minor injuries.

All four agents have identified Adolf Hitler as the target, with very high confidence (0.97-1.00). This is historically accurate and well-documented. The plot is one of the most famous assassination attempts in modern history.

There is no ambiguity here - the target was definitively Adolf Hitler.
